question:
Which of the** option figure **when rotated 135° clockwise and then 45° anticlockwise will result in the given question figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd588e8e6950b9aaa583ed72d9d4cef299ed45fe2a7e3df65bd8b46cb73338a1.png]
solution:
Check **"Option (3)"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a90f90ace08843e0d4a11ccab9507c11ac74a81f3ab017cd9ee6a2929c856a15.png]
